headlines.text: It was 2023 when the ROH World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Aussie Open vs. The Hardys went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.43. For The Hardys, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 10th match in ROH World Tag Team Titles history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Back on this day in 2024, it was Cage, Mortos & TV's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.49.
It was 2025 when it marked the first-ever meeting between Konosuke Takeshita and Tomohiro Ishii on Collision, rated 7.84 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when Fox & Strickland kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a strong outing.
